title: Richmond, Aug. 30, 2004: where Gaston's rain fell
about: Working draft for the floods series (Opus 5.5 subagent, Nov. 23, 2026): the storm-total rain of Tropical Storm Gaston, from the KAKQ radar corrected to gauges, painted on the ground of the city as it stood in 2004. Made in code with Claude; see tools/floods/rain/.

epochs.title: Richmond, Aug. 30, 2004: Gaston's rain
epochs.note: Buildings the city dates to 2004 or before, and the storm's total rain on the ground.
